messages:
alexa: Heads-up: planning a 2-week stability sprint next week. Need to split items into MUST-fix (stability) vs NICE-to-have (post-stability backlog). Quick thoughts and reactions only pls.

mike: Agree on a short list. Can we get a concrete rubric so engineers know what to pick?

alexa: Draft rubric: 
- Must-fix (move into stability sprint): user-facing correctness, data integrity loss, crashes, regressions increasing p95 >20% on core flows, multi-customer production impact (>3).
- Triage candidates (evaluate during sprint): intermittent 502/504 spikes and routing-related errors.
- Backlog enhancements: new UX polish, non-breaking API opt-ins, extended structured output features.

sam: Add one: any billing or accounting discrepancies = immediate P0. Reported by customers or by billing runs.

jessie: Also: items touching API contracts should be treated conservatively. If change could break older clients, plan as enhancement but add a canary/compat strategy.

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: prod v1.4.3 at 09:12 UTC. No automated rollbacks triggered.

alexa: Noted a short burst of 502s in the first hour after deploy. Mike, did you get a trace?

mike: Yep. Looks like model-proxy to variant-b timed out during high concurrency. Example log: ```ERROR: proxy dial tcp: i/o timeout; upstream=model-variant-b; conn_retries=3```

sam: Short-term mitigation: shift 10-15% traffic away from variant-b to variant-a and monitor for 2 hours. If error rate drops, open an eng-runtime ticket to investigate kernel/connection pool sizing.

jessie: +1 to the routing tweak. For visibility, add a dashboard panel showing variant-level 5xxs and p95 by route.

alexa: Plan: 1) Apply routing tweak now (10%->variant-a). 2) Sam to add variant panel. 3) Mike to open root-cause ticket with logs. If errors persist, escalate to rollback variant-b.

mike: I'll file the ticket and attach heatmap and p95 deltas. Also estimating KV cache warmup improvements is important
—runtime says prototype 3d + 2d QA. That could be in stability sprint as performance work.

jessie: For backlog: three customers asked for structured chat outputs (JSON schema + validation). Estimate 5-8d engineering, plus API docs updates. Mark as post-stability enhancement unless customers pressure it as critical.

alexa: Decision checklist for the sprint board: P0/P1 rules from rubric, routing incidents go to triage, cross-customer features get bumped up. I'll lock tickets by EOD if no objections.

release-bot: On-call handoff scheduled: eng-oncall at 09:00 UTC Monday.

sam: Quick note: for any hotfix we should use the canary lane and limit scope to config/routing when possible. Saves churn.

mike: Agreed. Also suggest we reserve a half-day on Thursday for retro + backlog re-eval.

jessie: I'll collate customer asks into a single PRD with tradeoffs and include a migration plan for API changes.

alexa: Cool. If everyone is good: react with :shipit: and I will move chosen tickets into the stability sprint board and publish a short triage guide.

mike: :shipit:

sam: :shipit:

jessie: :shipit:

alexa: Thanks all — closing thread and posting the sprint board updates shortly.
